title: Berlin 2018: archived call for Forum submissions
body:
Archived deadline notice

The following wording is preserved from the historical submission page. It is not an invitation to submit a proposal today.

CALL FOR PRESENTATIONS IS OPEN.

The former application let speakers manage their own submissions. Submission, editing and deletion actions are closed in this archive.

Browse the Berlin 2018 archive

description: Historical Berlin 2018 guidance. Submissions, voting and review actions are closed.
archiveNotice: Historical Berlin 2018 archive. All submission, voting and review actions for this page are closed. Instructions and deadlines below are retained only for reference.
